document_title: Safety Abort, Data Invalidation & E-Stop Acceptance Specification V2
daq_isolation_mandate: RESEARCH DAQ HAS ZERO VEHICLE ACTUATION AUTHORITY. Experimental data acquisition software is completely isolated from vehicle throttle, steering, and braking lines. A data loss event (frame drop, CAN timeout, PTP degradation) terminates data capture and logs ABORTED_DATA_INVALID; it DOES NOT issue an automated emergency stop to the vehicle.

safety_abort.definition: Immediate hardware-level intervention invoked strictly to preserve human safety or asset integrity.
safety_abort.control_path: Hardwired, fail-safe, dual-channel Cat 4 / SIL-3 safety circuit.
safety_abort.actuation: Main battery/traction contactor de-energization; mechanical failsafe brake engagement.
safety_abort.authority: Safety Marshal, Certified Vehicle Operator, Perimeter Gate Interlocks.
triggers: Depression of manual or wireless emergency stop (E-Stop) push-button.
Physical opening of perimeter safety fence gate interlock switch.
Optical light curtain intrusion detection across test track boundary.
Unplanned human entry into test buffer or dynamic vehicle envelope.
Vehicle steering runaway, mechanical collision, or tire deflation.

data_invalidation_abort.definition: Software-level event package invalidation due to sensor failure, timing violation, or packet loss.
data_invalidation_abort.control_path: Experimental Linux DAQ user-space software daemon.
data_invalidation_abort.actuation: Mark active JSON manifest as ABORTED_DATA_INVALID; flush and close media handles; move directory to outputs/aborted_runs/.
data_invalidation_abort.vehicle_consequence: NO ACTUATOR COMMAND ISSUED. Vehicle continues under native human/autonomous control and completes run or stops via standard operational procedures.
data_invalidation_abort.authority: Automated DAQ Quality Monitor or Data Operations Lead.
triggers: Camera A, B, or C drops >= 1 video frame during active trial window.
CAN bus message gap > 20.0 ms for vehicle speed or brake state.
PTP Grandmaster loses GNSS lock, or local clock slave offset > 5.0 ms.
NVMe capture buffer queue exceeds 80% capacity.
SHA-256 hash or Merkle tree computation failure during session close.

estop_physical_acceptance_specification.target_metric: Vehicle traction power disconnect latency upon E-Stop depression

epistemic_classification.current_prototype_status: UNVERIFIED_PENDING_MEASUREMENT (NEVER report design target as measured result)

acceptance_evidence_fields.field_test_method: Dual-channel high-speed digital storage oscilloscope recording E-Stop NC contact break (Channel 1) vs Main Contactor auxiliary feedback contact opening (Channel 2).

measured_cutoff_latency_ms.description: Actual measured delta in milliseconds. MUST be <= 50.0 ms to PASS Gate C8.
